name: devhub-copilot
description: GitHub Copilot code completions and Next Edit Suggestions, drawn by the editor's own inline suggestion UI, from the Copilot language server. No chat.

devhub.copilot.enable.description: Run the Copilot language server and offer its suggestions.

devhub.copilot.completions.enabled.description: Offer Copilot code completions as ghost text at the cursor.

devhub.copilot.nextEditSuggestions.enabl.description: Offer Copilot Next Edit Suggestions: edits anywhere near the cursor, shown with the editor's inline edit UI. How they are drawn is set by the editor.inlineSuggest.edits.* settings.

devhub.copilot.nextEditSuggestions.exten.description: Let Next Edit Suggestions propose edits farther from the cursor.

devhub.copilot.nextEditSuggestions.renam.description: Let Next Edit Suggestions follow a local rename to the symbol's other uses.

devhub.copilot.debug.logging.description: Log the language server protocol traffic, with secret-like values redacted, to the Copilot output.

scripts.fmt:check: prettier --check src scripts test package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.fmt: prettier --write src scripts test package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint
